description.text: Teaching Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. MainCourses Introduction on Computer & Base on C Program Programming in C Computer Practice Sports (I-III) Advanced Mathematics A(I-II) Probability Statistics Information Retrieval English of Technical Terms Digital Logic Circuit Design Discrete Mathematics Data Structure Operating System1 Electrotechnics Computer Organization Internship Cognition Practice, Social Investigation/Study-abroad Program, Integrated Course Desig, Corporation Internship, Graduate Project (Thesis). Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Computer Science and Technology

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
